title: Wicker Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 94
rules: If Wicker has a Tomatometer score of above 94 on Nov, 02, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Wicker is at 94% (46/49) on Rotten Tomatoes, one point below what's needed, and has risen steadily from 91% as recent reviews came in fresh. To get above 94 it must hold about 95%+ positivity across roughly 50-80 more reviews expected by Nov 2. That's possible given the trend, but a Metacritic score of about 64 points to lukewarm critics still to come, and scores usually slip after wide release.
blind.falsifier: The Tomatometer showing 95% or higher on Nov 2 at 10 AM ET (e.g., the fresh streak continuing through the Oct 23 and Oct 30 releases with at most 2-3 new rotten reviews).

final.reasoning: My data is a few days old and traders likely see newer reviews since release, which probably explains the lower price, so I moved from 0.34 to 0.23. The small remaining edge isn't worth betting on with stale information.
